title: SMOK V8-Baby Q2 Dual Core Coils
description: Replacement coils for the Smok TFV8 Baby Beast tank. These are the smaller counterpart to the powerful TFV8 Cloud Beast coils but still pack a punch and promise to deliver plenty of vapour and pure flavour. These coils work best when used between 55 and 65 Watts. At Vapestore we stock a large range of SMOK Products, including Smok E-cigarettes , Smok Tanks , Mods , Smok Coils and New Vape kits
